memos.risk:
Risk officer read: this is a refuse, or at most a skip-with-watch.

Pool depth is 56 SOL, so a $20 ticket is about 0.1 SOL against a shallow pool, and round-trip impact plus fees will likely eat 5% or more. The coin is down 70% from its 30-minute high and 50% over 30 minutes, with a launch bot present and a sell-to-buy ratio of 0.92 in the first two minutes. Net flow over the last 15 minutes is only +3.4 SOL against 45.7 SOL sold. Class is UNRESOLVED, the curve and graduation fields are null, and name and symbol are null, so we can't check for airdrop or operator backing.

Refuse any size. If the desk overrides, the minimum would be a $5 ticket, a 20% stop, and a 15-minute hold, but I don't recommend it. Revisit only if the class resolves to operator-backed with a clean curve and positive net flow over several intervals.
memos.scout:
The strongest case for buying is narrow. In the last 15 minutes the coin shows real two-sided activity: 135 buyers against 84 sellers, 49 SOL bought versus 46 sold, and a net inflow of 3.4 SOL. Price is up 8.5% over that window after a 70% drawdown from the 30-minute high, which can read as a bounce. The top-5 buyer share at launch was only 28%, and there is no airdrop dump or bundle concentration flagged, so this does not look like a factory coin. About 11.6k USD of volume in 15 minutes and a 56 SOL pool suggest the market is not dead.

The case is weak, though. Net flow is small relative to gross volume, the early sell-to-buy ratio of 0.92 means early holders were already exiting, and a 70% drawdown with an 8.5% bounce is more consistent with a dead-cat move than a demand floor. Curve, graduation, and metadata data are all missing, so we cannot confirm operator backing. Against a 1.4-5.1% round-trip cost and a base rate of roughly -20% for timed buys, I don't see enough evidence that demand will persist 30-60 minutes out. Recommendation: skip.
memos.skeptic: The most likely loss path is a slow bleed from insider distribution with fees eating any bounce. The coin is already 70% off its 30-minute high and sits at -50% over 30 minutes, so the dip is deep and momentum is negative. Over the last 15 minutes, sellers (84) and sell volume (45.66 SOL) nearly match buy volume (49.09 SOL), and net flow is only +3.43 SOL, so there is no real demand absorbing supply. The first two minutes show a sell-to-buy ratio of 0.92 and a launch bot present, which fits early holders exiting into the buying pressure. Bundle share and completer share are unknown, so insider control can't be ruled out. Even if the 8.5% recent return holds, round-trip costs of 1.4-5.1% on a $22k cap with 56 SOL of pool depth would eat much of it. Recommendation: skip.
